consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 12/09/1979 show at Kiel Auditorium features high energy and strong performances, particularly highlighting Jerry's guitar work and the overall flow of the setlist. Standout moments include impressive renditions of 'Shakedown Street' and 'Terrapin Station,' which many reviewers found particularly enjoyable.
